profile.headline: Associate Pathways Software Engineer at Peraton
profile.summary:
I am a solution-oriented computer scientist engineer with a range of professional experience and passion for software-modularity and development for next-generation technology.  I am very self-motivated and self-taught for almost all technical skills with both academic and professional experience to back those skills up. 

My academic experiences cover a large range of software oriented solutions including big data, high performance computing, and systems level programming.  Further I am currently assisting research for Borderline Personality Disorder by developing software solutions and machine learning algorithms to analyze test results.

My professional experiences involve internships in both the space industry at NASA Goddard and in the cyber industry at Northrop Grumman.  In both experiences, I have had many software experiences that include automation, front-end development, database management, full-stack development, and machine learning.

positions.title: Cyber Software Summer Intern
positions.description:
* Created setup instructions for  VM development environment for web applications utilizing Java, Neo4J, JavaScript, Wildfly, and Postgresql.
* Utilized Cesium.JS to implement geospatial visualization of cyber networks to plan and prevent cyber attacks.
* Developed widgets to save web application status to a Neo4J database.
* Designed algorithm to automatically identify important networks in cyber space to allow users to only look at important assets
* Created radial context menu to allow users to quickly interact with network assets such as disconnecting, marking as important, or pivoting globally in all screens.
* Developed Jenkins pipeline to allow for highly parametrized builds including multiple branch use for multiple Git repositories

positions.title: Software Research Assistant
positions.description:
* Strategized and designed systems for experiments to allow for high accuracy timing, scalability, low-overhead, and use of speciﬁc hardware such as the CedrusResponseBox. 
* Developed MATLAB experiment to examine Pavlovian responses to reward utilizing PsychToolBox.
* Incorporated various machine learning features including K-Nearest Neighbors and Reinforcement Learning techniques to act as an advanced AI for an experiment. 
* Taught skills such as Git, Python, and Matlab to a non-technical audience both informal and informal presentations.

positions.title: Space Robotics Engineer
positions.description:
* Developed software in OpenGL for robotics camera simulation.
* Created GUI to perform rigid body analysis of asteroids on robotics using Matlab.
* Programmed and modeled new functionality for a robotic trajectory analysis tool in Matlab.
* Developed robotic software in C++ on a Raspberry Pi to demonstrate the use of robotics at NASA.
* Developed tasks and outreach activities such as developing robotic hardware/software for drawing the NASA logo utilizing inverse kinematics.
* Created automated method of simplifying CAD models in Blender with Python
* Programmed Blender plugins to automatically generate models for OpenSceneGraph.
